objective: Add a windows-latest job to .github/workflows/ci.yml that installs the toolchain the existing Linux test job uses and runs the test suite, so Windows failures show up on every PR.
constraints: Mirror the existing Linux job's setup steps (Bun canary through mise or however ci.yml installs it today); pin actions the same way the file already does.

The job reports failures; do not mark it continue-on-error unless the existing file has a pattern for known-failing jobs; if you think it should be non-blocking at first, say so in the report instead of deciding. Fixing Windows test failures is out of scope.
Only edit .github/workflows/ci.yml. Validate YAML syntax locally (e.g. parse it with Bun). No version-control writes, no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Keep working until done; stop and report. Report in under 250 words.

criteria.text: windows job: a windows-latest job runs the test suite with the same toolchain setup as the Linux job
yaml valid: ci.yml parses and existing jobs are unchanged
